summary: 78-year-old male with dementia walked away from a hunting camp at Ripple Creek in the early morning hours without shoes, a hunting rifle, or provisions; the Rio Blanco County Sheriff's Office dispatched search and rescue with a SARDOC tracking-dog team plus a Classic Air Medical helicopter; ground teams tracked him a distance, radioed the last-track coordinates, and the helicopter spotted him over a rise. Located safe, will be okay.
responding_agency: Rio Blanco County SO / Rio Blanco County SAR; SARDOC dog team; Classic Air Medical
notes: Resolves the parked 2019-10-19 Ripple Creek Pass lead (SARDOC 2019 Public Mission Summaries PDF noted dog-team assets stood down with no outcome); the Basin Now piece (parent-opened) supplies dated corroboration with a positive outcome. Date = Saturday 2019-10-19, weekday-verified.
